tpu_topology_comparison.query_summary: TPU-inside (our captive-core Design F) vs TPU-outside (Ye et al. core-wrapping) — which topology is better for lander/egg-drop and crutch-tip?
tpu_topology_comparison.key_finding: captive-core (TPU inside PLA) preferred over core-wrapping (TPU outside PLA) for both use cases; PLA-TPU adhesion 0.37-0.39 MPa is too variable to trust
tpu_topology_comparison.manuscript_note: The manuscript's Ye et al. core-wrapping claim (lines 378-382) is incorrect — we use the opposite topology. Edison provided corrected text.
